said.created: Draft saved. Only admins can read it until you publish it.
said.savedLive: Saved. Readers see the new text now.
said.published: Published. It is on the Stories page and the home shelf: [read it](/blog/{slug}).
said.unpublished: Unpublished. It is a draft again, off the Stories page and the home shelf.

said.post_invalid: Soma refused it: the slug is lower-case letters and digits in words joined by hyphens (up to 80), the title one line of 1 to 120 characters, and the text at most 100,000.
said.published_invalid: Soma did not read that as publish or unpublish. Reload and try again.
said.slug_taken: Another post already has that slug. Pick another.
said.admin_only: This account is no longer an admin.

refusals.needTitle: Give the post a title and a slug first.
refusals.unreachable: The API did not answer; nothing was saved.
